title: Clean-label Poisoning Attack and Defense Game for Federated Learning in Vehicular Networks
abstract: arXiv:2610.32765v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: This paper studies interactions between clean-label poisoning attack and defense in vehicular networks using federated learning (FL). Basic Safety Message (BSM) classification for anomaly detection is modeled as a distributed learning problem over a vehicular network with dynamic topology. As a critical threat to FL, a feature-space clean-label attack is introduced, wherein benign samples are perturbed toward malicious feature extremes, degrading class separability while preserving labels. To counter this, a feature-consistency relabeling defense is proposed to detect and relabel suspicious samples. A game-theoretic framework is developed to capture attack-defense interactions and characterize equilibrium strategies based on attack effectiveness and cost parameters. translated_title: 车联网中联邦学习的干净标签投毒攻击与防御博弈
translated_abstract: 本文研究了车联网中使用联邦学习（FL）时干净标签投毒攻击与防御之间的交互。基本安全消息（BSM）的异常检测分类被建模为在具有动态拓扑结构的车联网上的分布式学习问题。作为联邦学习面临的关键威胁，本文引入了一种特征空间的干净标签攻击，该攻击将良性样本向恶意特征极端方向扰动，在保持标签不变的同时降低类间可分性。为应对这一攻击，提出了一种特征一致性重标记防御方法，用于检测并重新标记可疑样本。此外，构建了一个博弈论框架来刻画攻防双方之间的交互，并基于攻击有效性与成本参数来表征均衡策略。结果表明，该攻击随被攻陷节点数量的增加而有效扩展，而所提出的防御方法能够在不降低干净样本准确率的前提下将攻击成功率保持在较低水平，并使均衡策略发生……（原文摘要截断于此）
tldr: 该论文针对车联网联邦学习提出了一种特征空间干净标签投毒攻击与特征一致性重标记防御方法，并通过博弈论框架刻画攻防均衡策略，在不损害正常检测准确率的情况下将攻击成功率维持在低水平。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a feature-space clean-label poisoning attack and a feature-consistency relabeling defense for federated learning in vehicular networks, and develops a game-theoretic framework to characterize equilibrium attack-defense strategies that keep attack success low without degrading clean accuracy.
